name: v3 spice sweep — Pass 1 (single-knob screen)
description: 10 arms of one Jarir take (seed 2640605763, cap 6500), each differing by exactly one knob from the v3 final adapter (final/5000, scale 1.0/1.0, cot=off): guidance_scale 1.5/2.5, semantic_temperature 1.2/1.4, semantic_repetition_penalty 1.4, AR scale 0.7, or checkpoint 4500/3500/2500. Question: does any knob lift the take from 'flat / generic' (the 4/5 baseline) toward 5/5 — more improvisation and character — WITHOUT costing diction. summary_metric = spice.

criteria.label: Overall quality
criteria.help: Your gut call on the whole take.

criteria.label: Improvisation / spice
criteria.help: PRIMARY metric. Does the composer take risks — improvised taqsim, mawwal-like phrasing, call-and-response, unexpected turns — or does it feel like a safe, generic render? This is exactly the 'flat / generic' problem the sweep targets.

criteria.label: Melodic interest / memorability
criteria.help: Is the melodic line compelling and memorable, or background music?

criteria.label: Vocal presence / performance
criteria.help: Does the voice have character and commitment, or sound flat and on autopilot?

criteria.label: Arrangement / dynamics
criteria.help: Instrumental variation, builds, dynamic contrast — or one texture throughout?

criteria.label: Structural coherence / lyrics held
criteria.help: Does the song hold together and deliver the lyrics, or wander / loop / lose the thread?

criteria.label: Arabic diction (guardrail)
criteria.help: Pronunciation clarity. A 'spice' win must NOT cost diction — rate this even when it isn't your focus.

criteria.label: Better than the ref take (the 4/5 baseline)?
criteria.help: ref = the v3 final adapter, default sampler — byte-identical to your original probe take 0. Judge each arm relative to it.

criteria.label: Notes
criteria.help: Timecodes for loops / artifacts, the exact word if diction breaks, and what stood out.
